releaseNotes: Nop thay don vi: Phong KT&DBCL scan va nop van ban chi co ban giay, minh chung tinh cho dung don vi, ghi Noi luu ban goc (hien ca o cong doan danh gia ngoai). Quet OCR doc ban scan PDF ngay tren may chu, khong can AI online. Nhieu dot cung bo chuan: trang cua don vi, Tong quan theo dung Dot lam viec; o chon dot khong bi mat khi tai lai trang; ma minh chung danh so rieng tung dot; tai lieu dung chung tu gan dung ca ten co chu D. Gio hien thi dung gio Viet Nam (truoc lech 7 tieng). Bao cao trich Thong tu 04/2025, 20/2026. Word/Excel doan DGN tai ve co dong nhan dien nguoi xem.
